name: multi-step-loader
blurb: Full-screen multi-step loader with animated check icons and step progression.
description: A full-screen overlay loader that animates through loading states with check icons, supporting looping or single-pass progression through the sequence.
use_when: Showing sequential progress through multiple steps with visual feedback.
avoid_when: For simple spinners or when a modal isn't appropriate.
a11y: Displays step text and icons, no additional labels.
